headlines.title: American Express jumps 28 places on the Roundtable 100
headlines.summary: American Express jumps to No. 42 in the Roundtable 100.

headlines.title: Hyperscale Data Sells Remaining Bitcoin Holdings for $16 Million to Reduce Debt and Fund AI Data Center
headlines.summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. (AMEX:GPUS) announced that it has sold its remaining Bitcoin reserves for approximately $16 million, with proceeds being directed towards debt reduction and the continued development of its artificial intelligence data centre in Michigan.

headlines.title: American Express (AXP) Unveils Sports Rewards Card Tied To Fan Loyalty
headlines.summary: American Express (NYSE:AXP) and Fanatics have launched a new co-branded credit card focused on sports fans and bettors. The product links American Express Membership Rewards with Fanatics FanCash, allowing cardholders to direct points into the Fanatics ecosystem. Card users receive access to Fanatics-related experiences and merchandise offers that are tied to sports events and team loyalty programs.

headlines.title: American Express and Marriott Bonvoy® Expand Canadian Card Portfolio with New No-Annual-Fee Card and Enhanced Benefits
headlines.summary: American Express Canada and Marriott Bonvoy® are expanding their co-brand portfolio with the new Marriott Bonvoy Bright™ American Express® Card, a no-annual-fee Card launching February 9, 2027. The new Card will join the existing Marriott Bonvoy® American Express® and Marriott Bonvoy® Business American Express® Cards, which are being enhanced to include complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status.

headlines.title: Amex Membership Rewards points now convert to Fanatics FanCash: 1,000 points for $10
headlines.summary: Fanatics and American Express reveal the Fanatics American Express® Card and add Fanatics FanCash as a new transfer partner in the Membership Rewards program.

description: American Express Company, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated payments company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, the Asia Pacific, Australia, New Zealand, Latin America, Canada, the Caribbean, and internationally. It operates through four segments: U.S. Consumer Services, Commercial Services, International Card Services, and Global Merchant and Network Services. The company offers credit and charge cards and complementary products and services, including travel, dining, and lifestyle and expense management products and services; and banking and other payment and financing products and services, including deposits and non-card lending. It also provides merchant acquisition and processing, servicing and settlement, fraud prevention, and point-of-sale marketing and information products and services, as well as network services. The company offers its products and services to consumers, small businesses, mid-sized companies, and large corporations through mobile and online applications, affiliate marketing, customer referral programs, third-party service providers and business partners, in-house sales teams, direct mail, telephone, and direct response advertising. American Express Company was founded in 1850 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
